notes: Wingman now gives authoritative 6 GHz regulatory answers per country: the legal channel list, Preferred Scanning Channels, how many channels you get at each width (20/40/80/160/320 MHz), the power modes (LPI / VLP / Standard-Power), and whether AFC is available — all from a built-in per-country database rather than guessed.

Ask "what 6 GHz channels and power can I use in Germany / Japan / the US?" (or any band, any country) and Wingman reads it from the database with a confidence level and a reminder to confirm with the local regulator — it no longer answers these from memory, since 6 GHz rules differ sharply by country.
